messages:
emma-cs: Hey team, customer Acme reporting production errors after upgrading to the python SDK 1.12. Lots of 401s + `AuthError: token refresh failed` spikes. Repro steps below.
customer-acme: We bumped from 1.10.2 -> 1.12.0. First we saw `TypeError: __init__() got an unexpected keyword argument 'credentials'` then the app started retrying and flood of auth failures.
josh-eng: Hmm — 1.12 changed the client constructor: `credentials` was renamed to `auth` and auto-refresh became async-only. If app still calls the old kwarg it triggers the TypeError, then our retry layer kicks in.
emma-cs: Repro snippet they sent: 
```
# requirements.txt
redwood-sdk==1.12.0

# app.py
from redwood import Client
client = Client(credentials=my_creds)
resp = client.generate("hello")
```
Result: `TypeError: __init__() got an unexpected keyword argument 'credentials'` then repeated 401 refresh errors in logs.
maya-ml: That explains it. Breaking change slipped through. Immediate workaround: pin to the last non-breaking version and/or update code to the new kwarg. Two options: 
- Pin: `pip install 'redwood-sdk==1.11.3'` and restart.
- Code change: `Client(auth=my_creds)` and, if running sync code, set `sync_refresh=False` in the client or set env `REDWOOD_DISABLE_AUTO_REFRESH=1` to avoid the async refresh loop while you adapt.
kai-devops: Also note the retry defaults changed in 1.12 — it treats 401 like an auth-retry and will keep retrying. Recommend setting `REDWOOD_MAX_RETRIES=3` or pass explicit policy: `client = Client(..., retry_policy={"max_retries":3, "retry_on":[429,502,503,504]})`. That prevents runaway loops.
emma-cs: Customer asked for the exact one-liner to pin.
josh-eng: Tell them: `pip install --upgrade 'redwood-sdk==1.11.3'` then `systemctl restart app-workers` (or restart your process manager). If they prefer to stay on 1.12, code changes: replace `credentials=` with `auth=` and explicitly opt out of auto-refresh in sync contexts.
customer-acme: Pinned to 1.11.3, restarted workers — errors dropped to zero. Thanks. Any ETA on a compatibility patch?
maya-ml: We're preparing 1.12.1 to restore backwards-compat for the constructor alias and to tighten retry defaults for 401. ETA: today afternoon. I'll add a release note and migration guide that calls out `credentials -> auth` rename and the refresh behavior change.
emma-cs: I'll update the ticket with the pin instructions and the env var suggestion, and flag the customer for follow-up post-release. :thumbsup:
support-bot: Incident created INC-2026-45 linked to this thread (1845678901).
